analysis.session_summary: The tape was dominated by a firm USD and weak GBP: USD's mean vs majors was +0.104% while GBP printed -0.202% and CAD -0.128%. The high-impact US retail sales beat (1.4% vs 0.6%) produced a muted basket impulse of -0.010%, and UK CPI in line at 3.1% still left GBP lower with an own-ccy impulse of -0.062%. Brent fell 2.783% despite the late Saudi pipeline headline, and SPX/VIX risk appetite improved (SPX +0.263%, VIX -0.702).

themes.theme: USD firm but data reaction muted
themes.evidence: USD mean vs majors +0.104%; DXY +0.1%; Core Retail Sales actual 1.4% vs forecast 0.6% but basket impulse -0.010%.
GBP mean -0.202%; GBP/USD -36.3 pips; UK CPI actual 3.1% vs forecast 3.1%, own-ccy impulse -0.062%.

themes.theme: Oil weakness and commodity FX pressure
themes.evidence: Brent/USD -2.783%; Saudis Seek To Resume Half Of Key Oil Pipeline Within Days; CAD mean -0.128% and USD/CAD +28.3 pips.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: The pair carved a 28.2-pip range and closed -8.2 pips lower, with multiple no-catalyst legs before the high-confidence 4.4-pip US retail sales leg settled it near the lows.

polarity_reads.read: An inline UK CPI (3.1% vs 3.1%) produced a -0.062% own-ccy impulse, suggesting the market was positioned for a stronger print or is fading GBP longs on the lack of upside surprise.
A strong 1.4% vs 0.6% US retail sales beat generated only a -0.010% basket impulse inside the noise floor, implying USD was already well-positioned ahead of FOMC or data strength is being faded.

scenarios.name: FOMC hawkish / USD extends
scenarios.thesis: Fed delivers the expected 4.00% hike and a hawkish dot plot, reinforcing the already firm USD tone.
triggers: Federal Funds Rate prints 4.00% as forecast
FOMC Economic Projections show higher terminal rate
FOMC Press Conference signals further hikes
scenarios.invalidation: FOMC holds at 3.75% or press conference pushes back against further hikes.

pair_paths.rationale: FOMC hike and dot plot reinforce USD; EUR/USD tests the session's 28.2-pip range low.
GBP already weak with mean -0.202% and GBP/USD -36.3 pips, extending the 52.3-pip range lower on USD strength.
Higher US yields on a hawkish FOMC lift USD/JPY within its 60.1-pip range.

scenarios.name: FOMC neutral-dovish / USD profit-taking
scenarios.thesis: FOMC signals less urgency or holds, triggering profit-taking on stretched USD longs after the muted retail sales reaction.
triggers: FOMC holds at 3.75% contrary to 4.00% forecast
scenarios.invalidation: FOMC delivers 25bp hike with hawkish dot plot and USD/JPY breaks above its 60.1-pip range high.

pair_paths.rationale: Market fades the USD data beat after FOMC signals less urgency; EUR/USD reverses within its 28.2-pip range.
A dovish FOMC or USD profit-taking unwinds GBP/USD's -36.3 pips toward the 52.3-pip range high.
Dovish FOMC pushes USD/JPY back down its 60.1-pip range.

scenarios.name: FOMC neutral and risk-off / range
scenarios.thesis: Fed delivers expected 4.00% but no new hawkish signal, leaving markets in a risk-off holding pattern and majors range-bound.
triggers: FOMC delivers expected 4.00% but no new hawkish dots
scenarios.invalidation: A decisive FOMC hike or dovish BOE breaks EUR/USD out of its 28.2-pip range.

pair_paths.rationale: FOMC neutral and risk-off leaves EUR/USD trapped in its 28.2-pip range.
Mixed FOMC/BOJ impulses keep USD/JPY inside its 60.1-pip range.
CAD weakness offset by oil uncertainty contains USD/CAD within its 33.3-pip range.
